messages:
Marta: Hey team — first day! Quick K8s access q: I can't see any contexts after I run `kubectl config get-contexts`. I was told to ask here. Need prod/dev namespaces access to run port-forwards for local testing. :confused:

jessi-devex: welcome Marta! :partyparrot: Did you finish the onboarding checklist? There's a step to run the SSO helper and then fetch kubeconfigs. Try `kubectl config view --minify` to see what your current context is.

Marta: yep ran the checklist but my kubeconfig only has a single context called `local-docker`. No redwood contexts show up.

ricky-enginfra: fyi we provision k8s access via the onboarding form -> SA + RBAC. I can check. @Marta which team/region did you pick on the form?

Marta: selected "eng/runtime" and "us-west".

kyle-sre: quick workaround — if you need to port-forward immediately, I can create a temporary impersonation token for Marta scoped to the `dev` namespace for 2 hours. Want me to do that?

Marta: yes please, that'd be awesome 🙏

onboarding-bot: Created ticket #INF-4827 for k8s onboarding. Eng-infra assigned: ricky-enginfra.

ricky-enginfra: done — added you to the `eng-runtime-dev` role, should appear in your kubeconfig after re-running the SSO login. Steps: 1) `company-sso login` 2) `onboardctl fetch-kubeconfig --team eng-runtime --region us-west` 3) `kubectl config use-context redwood-usw-eng-runtime-dev`

jessi-devex: also added the KB link: https://go.redwood/workflows/k8s-onboard (contains exact commands and permissions matrix).

Marta: re-ran `company-sso login` and `onboardctl` — I see the new context! Thank you!! :tada: Quick q — how to default to dev namespace? I keep forgetting to pass `-n`.

ricky-enginfra: you can set the context namespace: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=eng-runtime-dev` or `kubectl config set-context redwood-usw-eng-runtime-dev --namespace=eng-runtime-dev`.

kyle-sre: note — long-term we'll give you a kubeconfig that scopes to your SA. For now, we granted role `edit` in `eng-runtime-dev`. If you need prod access, that needs an extra approval flow (sec review + product sign-off).

Marta: understood, thanks everyone!

jessi-devex: welcome aboard Marta — ping us if anything else blocks you :party:
